cards.front: Choose the shortest-path algorithm for each graph condition.
cards.back:
| Graph condition | Algorithm |
| --- | --- |
| Unweighted or uniform positive weights | BFS |
| Non-negative weights | Dijkstra |
| Directed acyclic graph, even with negative weights | DAG shortest paths |

With adjacency lists, BFS and DAG shortest paths run in \(O(V+E)\). Heap-based Dijkstra runs in \(O((V+E)\log V)\).
